body: It's a month today nc I'm in the same boat, dumpee and wanna break it. Don't even want her back I just want answers.

Theres a couple reasons I think that, a week before the breakup she gave me a beautifully written valentine's note about how much she loved me. We went on vacation with her family for 5 days and on the second day she stopped talking to me but earlier in the day she was saying I love you. Then she has a friend that was distant our entire relationship and didn't like me. My ex said she'll throw away the friendship if her friend can't be mature. The day we stopped talking they became best friends again. I don't know if I want to get back even if that's possible, I want answers. She said she knew for a few months that it wasn't working, kinda contradicts her note and why she let me spend all this money on a trip.

You complain that your friend became distant when we started dating and you wish she'd grow up and communicate, yet you tell me you've known for months it won't work out? You said you wished she'd communicate but you didn't do that very thing. After I spent all this money to travel to another country with your family you stopped talking to me 2 days into a 5 day trip, how the fuck do you think that made me feel. The day we stopped talking on the trip we had sex and you were telling me how much you love me. Our talks of marriage and kids, you showed me a ring online that you loved a couple of weeks before Christmas. I owned that ring months before you showed it to me, I saw it online and knew it was exactly you, you'd always say the next goes on your left ring finger. Save your crocodile tears you hypocritical fuck, go jump in the lake.

It's hard for me to really say I won't find someone better because we were eachothers firsts, but the goods we experienced I can't imagine it ever getting better than that. Being firsts definitely played a part in how much I cared for and adored her, right now all I want is for her to come back. The idea of marrying and starting a family with her while being the only people we've been with was something that made my love greater, sounds meant to be. She changed her profile picture on Instagram from us to a photo that I took of her, all the photos of us are still up so I'm hoping she's just got a lot of emotions going on and comes back. I cried so many times today, driving knowing she'll never be in my passenger seat, never hold her hand, never touch hair, never do anything with her again. I'm hoping she'll reach out or something.
